skills.name: linkedin_draft_post
skills.description: Draft and stage a LinkedIn post through the LinkedIn Department (A3 PostWriter -> A10 Humanizer -> A12 Scheduler). The post is placed in the review queue for user approval before publishing.

topic.description: The technical or strategic topic to write about.

formula_code.description: Hook formula code (e.g. F7 Odd-Precision Ledger, F1 Platform Risk, F2 Obituary, F10 Contrarian, F3 Pivot).

pillar.description: Content pillar (Authority & Build Logs, Actionable Frameworks, Founder Story & Vulnerability, Contrarian & Perspective).

skills.name: linkedin_plan_sprint
skills.description: Plan a multi-day LinkedIn content calendar balancing content pillars and hook formulas via A2 ContentPlanner.

days.description: Number of days in the sprint horizon (e.g. 7 or 14).

skills.name: linkedin_audit_profile
skills.description: Audit the 9 core LinkedIn profile components and generate an authority rewrite and positioning thesis via A1 ProfileOptimizer.

current_profile.description: Current profile text including headline, about, and experience.

skills.name: linkedin_pending_reviews
skills.description: List all staged LinkedIn posts currently awaiting user review and approval in the department review queue.

skills.name: linkedin_approve_post
skills.description: Record user approval for a staged post in the LinkedIn Department review queue. Optionally publish immediately.

post_id.description: The post ID to approve (e.g. post_20261106_072633_f7).

publish_now.description: If true, immediately publishes to the user's live LinkedIn feed upon approval.

skills.name: linkedin_sync_profile
skills.description: Synchronize live authenticated profile data from LinkedIn via Composio into local department state.

skills.name: linkedin_propose_tool
skills.description: Use the Omarchy API Agent Daemon to reverse-engineer and propose a blueprint for a missing LinkedIn API capability.

problem.description: Description of the missing operation (e.g. 'extract comments on a post', 'fetch follower count').
